A Monte Carlo simulation to evaluate downside risk in a multi-asset portfolio 
(SPY / IEF / GLD), estimating historical VaR and CVaR and simulating extreme-loss 
stress scenarios.

**Tools:** Python, yfinance, pandas, numpy, matplotlib
